p_model_definition: p_model = P(graded side) / (P(under) + P(over)) at the leg line (push removed; equal to P(side) on x.5)
p_under_definition: p_under = P(rush_yds < line) over all sim trials; p_over = P(rush_yds > line); half lines never push
rush_yds_definition: player_box rush_yds + kneel_yds (official-stat convention: kneel-downs are rushes); 0 in trials with no carry
